push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.3. That ranks as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Proud of you, partner.

THE GOOD
+ 31 passes, your busiest match yet. Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles. Clean win, no foul, ball's ours. Beautiful.
+ A goal against Dagestan SC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. Everybody wants to play with someone who plays like that.
+ Man of the Match in a losing side: the bright spot on a dark night. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 8, up from your usual 4. That's where the match slipped.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Keep pushing; 6+ is within reach.
- Key passes: 1. Push for 2+ and you're elite company.
- A one-goal loss (1-2): a single moment decided it. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.

Quick drill: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

buddskees, from me to you: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, the 6.5 doesn't tell the whole story. It's one chapter, and you're still writing the book.

THE GOOD
+ Shot accuracy 100%, up from your usual 63%. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Passes attempted 24, from 17 in your previous match. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Key note: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Feet first, then flair.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Let's try: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- You and PhogsToffees both got caught on forcing passes. Fix it together: give each other short options.
- 1.2 under your usual. Bad days are tuition for good ones.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (13 of 24). I've watched it twice. It doesn't get better. Fix it like this: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Rep it: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
A 6.4, PhogsToffees. We all get knocked down. The trick is getting up a little smarter.

THE GOOD
+ You and buddskees play like you've known each other since kindergarten.
+ 1 key pass earned you +0.2. Smart football.
+ Passes attempted 27, from 23 in your previous match. Small wins add up to big ones.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (18 of 27, down from your usual 76%). Between you and me: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder. Biscuits if you nail it.
- That's your 4th worst match performance of the season with a 6.4. We go again.
- BellyTb1 struggled with forcing passes too. Work on it as a pair: give each other short options.
- In our wins you average 1 assists; here it was 0. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.

THE UGLY
! 1 of 2 shots on target. I'm gonna be straight with you: that's not good enough, and you know it. Focus point: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Pre-match routine: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Stay hungry, stay humble. - Coach Lasso
